title: Name-link overrides
description: Pins one name token in one passage or note to one person. A pin wins over the Tubal context rule. The linker never guesses when a token matches more than one person and nothing here, or that rule, selects a record.

unit_id.description: A Raleigh passage id (p00001) or a note id (note:person:jubal:description).

token.description: The printed name to pin, as one or more words. Matching ignores case and treats i/j and u/v as the same letter.
